cells.tense: The direction is chosen and holds and the day can be lived inside it.
cells.act: mark the good thing together, the day it happens
cells.ask: When something you picked comes true this week, mark it that same day with whoever helped — a message, a toast, ten minutes at the kitchen table — before you sleep.
cells.core:
You can pick a direction and hold it without clenching. The choice stays put while the day moves under it, and people feel the hold and don't feel handled. What you keep is the line itself, not your grip on it.

What this balance is free to feed next is the celebration of the people alongside you. When something you chose comes true, mark it the day it happens with whoever helped it come true — don't wait until the outcome is complete enough to deserve a table. Nature gives the shared joy along with the result. Celebration isn't a reward for holding the line. It's part of how the line gets held. Let the good thing land where the others can see it, and they don't have to guess it counted.

cells.tense: The direction will be defended so hard that the defending runs ahead of the day it is for.
cells.act: let the mind rest instead of working the problem
cells.ask: Pick a time this week when nothing needs deciding — a meal, a walk, an hour before bed — and leave the problem unworked through it. Not solved later. Unworked now.
cells.core:
The line is chosen, and something keeps scanning ahead for the argument that hasn't happened yet. Each load gets weighed before it lands, and that weighing is where the energy goes now. What was resolve becomes a way of carrying every objection four moves early, and the people near it can feel the summons before the trouble arrives.

Here the move is to put the mind down. Let the problem sit instead of working it. Pick a time this week when nothing needs deciding — a meal, a walk, an hour before you sleep — and leave the problem unworked through it. Not solved later; unworked now. The defense that runs ahead of its trouble is defending no one. The line you actually hold is smaller and nearer than that, and it holds while you rest.

cells.tense: The direction was chosen once and the person is at a door that is already behind them.
cells.ask: Hold where a decision you already made left you — the plan stays the plan, the yes stays yes, the no stays no. Keep its new shape. Don't reopen the argument with yourself or anyone.
cells.core:
Where direction gets chosen, the choice has happened and the momentum hasn't caught up to it. The move was made; the daily motion isn't running yet. From outside it reads as indecision, and from inside the permission hasn't arrived — and no one was ever going to send it.

More effort won't fill the empty line here. Keeping what the change produced will. Take a decision already made and hold its new shape: the plan stays the plan, the yes stays yes, the no stays no, and the argument doesn't get reopened in your own head. The ending was honored when it happened. This keeps what it produced. The daily motion doesn't start by pushing harder. It starts by leaving the door you closed closed.

cells.tense: The direction is being held capably in a room where it has stopped counting as chosen.
cells.act: make something skilled and small on the cleared ground
cells.ask: Make a small, complete version of something you're good at building — a meal, a repair, a lesson, a page — on the ground the last big change cleared. Finish it. Show no one unless you want to.
cells.core:
You can gather scattered energy and point it, and the pointing is steady. Ask about it and the answer comes out something like 'I just keep things moving' — as if it happened to you. The choice is real. The room's description of it is the only part that's off, and the room includes you when you explain yourself away.

What is simpler and earlier than the explaining is the building itself. Take a skill you have and make a finished small version on the cleared ground — a meal, a repair, a lesson, three paragraphs. Finish it. You will have been the one who chose the direction. The proof is a thing that exists. You don't have to raise the word choice to keep the work; the next small finished thing raises it for you.
